text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Fitted G-all+D1, as in the calendar figure. Heating is the sum of four hinges of trailing-mean temperature (6, 24, 72, and 168 hours) below 15.5 °C, shown for a steady temperature; the time series uses the ERA5 temperatures of the scored year. Lighting rises as the sun sinks.'
text.tspan: Fitted G-all+D1, as in the calendar figure. Heating is the sum of four hinges of trailing-mean
temperature (6, 24, 72, and 168 hours) below 15.5 °C, shown for a steady temperature; the time
series uses the ERA5 temperatures of the scored year. Lighting rises as the sun sinks.
